project_type: FileForgeWorkbench (FFWB) -- Rust cargo workspace; egui/eframe desktop app (ffwb binary in crate ff-desktop) plus many model crates including ff-screen-model and ff-scrm
build_system: cargo workspace. A custom `cargo gate` alias runs fmt+clippy+build+nextest full-suite (many minutes; the OWNER runs it manually). Agents compile-verify with SCOPED commands only.
test_framework: Rust built-in #[test] + cargo nextest; GUI tests use egui_kittest full-shell harness (harness_shell / build_eframe). pretty_assertions is available in ff-screen-model.
test_command: cargo test -p <crate> <focused-name>  (scoped; e.g. cargo test -p ff-screen-model redact, cargo test -p ff-desktop dialog_capture)
verification_instructions: Per .kiro/steering/gate-policy.md: on EVERY change run the scoped trio on the touched crate(s) -- `cargo check -p <crate>`, `cargo clippy -p <crate> -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt -p <crate> -- --check` -- plus the quick scoped tests near the change, and READ the logs back (verify by effect). Do NOT run `cargo gate`, `cargo nextest`, or whole-workspace `cargo test` as a verification step: those wedge the terminal and are the owner's manual run. Per terminal-discipline.md run shell commands via C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "..." and redirect long output to _ignore\logs\<unique>.log then read it. Never trust the reported Exit Code.
snapshot_or_generated_files: none for this task (no codegen; no new dependency expected -- do NOT add a dependency)
environment_constraints: Windows. Work ONLY in the worktree c:/workspace/apps/FileForgeWorkbench/.worktrees/scrm-2e-dialog-capture (branch scrm-2e). Use `git -C c:/workspace/apps/FileForgeWorkbench/.worktrees/scrm-2e-dialog-capture ...` for every git call. Relative paths resolve against the PARENT workspace, not the worktree -- always use the absolute worktree path. Commit locally on the branch; NEVER push. Logs go to <worktree>/_ignore/logs/ (git-ignored).
contribution_requirements: Build ON the existing framework (framework-conformance.md): single command dispatch via the ladder/front door -- NO second dispatcher, NO bespoke intercept. Capture ONLY through the existing ScreenProvider seam (active_screen_capture) and the existing ScreenCapture enum -- NO second mechanism. The TEXT model MUST come from the logical ScreenModel, never an egui pixel grab (the window SCREENSHOT picture is the existing Phase 2B picture flavor and is orthogonal). TDD is non-negotiable (testing.md): write the failing test FIRST, each annotated `// Validates: screen-snapshot-scrm Req 27.x`. No source .rs over 400 non-test lines; functions ~40 lines; split a test file before ~200 lines (rust-standards.md). ASCII-only source and docs (documentation-charset.md); the redaction placeholder `[REDACTED]` is ASCII; runtime Unicode box-drawing in rendered OUTPUT is allowed. Save-convention/focus-latch contracts for Context dialogs are UNCHANGED.
key_patterns: ScreenModel (crates/ff-screen-model/src/model.rs) already has FieldAttributes::sensitive + builder `FieldAttributes::plain().sensitive()`, but NO renderer masks a sensitive value (text/markdown/html/ansi emit value in clear; yaml adds a `sensitive: true` marker yet still prints the value). Redaction must therefore be added as a pure model transform `ScreenModel::redacted()` and applied BEFORE render so every flavor (text/md/html/ansi/raster/pdf) is masked from one source. active_screen_capture() in shell/screen_provider.rs returns ScreenCapture::{Model(Box<ScreenModel>),OptOut} by KindTag; per-Context builders live in shell/screen_providers.rs (build from the Context's own state, never egui). modal_open (computed in shell/update_input.rs from show_about / palette_state.open / show_history_list / show_swap_list / show_unsaved_workspace_dialog / reset_bare_confirm / pending_external, plus scrm_ui.save_as & replay_picker set in update_dialogs_scrm.rs) is the canonical frontmost-overlay signal. SNAPSHOT dispatches via shell/commands_ladder_b.rs (`if upper == "SNAPSHOT" ..`) -> handle_snapshot (shell/commands_snapshot.rs); the pure core is snapshot_text_for_active(&self, arg). Composite clipboard is clipboard_backend.rs (SnapshotPayload / SnapshotClipboard trait / OsClipboard / OfferedFlavors / FakeClipboard / unicode_text_bytes) + clipboard_html.rs + screenshot.rs. Dialog state structs: scrm_save_as_dialog.rs SaveAsState{name,directory,output_type}; reset-bare/external/unsaved/about/history/swap in update_dialogs.rs.
relevant_files: crates/ff-screen-model/src/render.rs (render entry + RenderOptions; renderers in render/{text,ansi,markdown,html,yaml}.rs)
crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_ladder_b.rs (SNAPSHOT ladder arm -- add COPY beside it)
directory_structure: crates/ff-screen-model/src/ -- logical screen model + pure renderers (no egui). crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/ -- WorkbenchShell split across many files (state.rs, screen_provider.rs, screen_providers.rs, commands_*.rs, update_*.rs, update_dialogs*.rs). crates/ff-desktop/src/*_dialog.rs + scrm_*.rs -- individual dialog modules.
